## Wave 1 Summary

Wave 1 is the session's flagship C1 cluster — the load-bearing emergent-Friedmann `a(t)` frontier. The substrate IS the Jensen-deformed spectral triple `(A_K, H_K, D_K(τ))`; "expansion" is not a metric stretching of a container but the growth of spectral complexity as the order parameter `τ` advances through and past the van Hove fold (`τ_fold = 0.190`). What an external acoustic observer reads as a scale factor `a(t)` is the conformal image of the substrate's order-parameter trajectory under the conformal factor `Ω(τ) = √(ρ_s / a₂)` — the order-parameter↔acoustic bridge that S95-W4-4 proved EXISTS (1+1D conformal embedding) and S96-W1 used implicitly, but which neither session EXPORTED as a numerical profile with its derivatives.

This wave (i) exports that conformal-factor prerequisite (`Ω(τ)`, `Ω̇`, `Ω̈`) over `τ ∈ [0.190, 0.6]` (gate 1.1, the structural BLOCKER); (ii) pins the substrate-determined `x_today = ρ_s/ρ_n` window via the two-fluid integration (gate 1.2); (iii) runs the A/B/C route-invariance discriminator transporting the two-fluid `q_Ω(x)` onto all three S96 H(τ) routes (gate 1.3); (iv) assembles the explicit physical-seconds `a(t)` trajectory (gate 1.4); and (v) tests whether the SCENARIO-A cooling budget over-determines `seconds-per-e-fold` tightly enough to PIN the `M_KK⁻¹→s` knob κ (gate 1.5). The carry-forward source is the S96 w1 workshop (`w1-q-omega-band-divergence.md`) which established the OMEGA-PROFILE/XTODAY/ROUTE-INVARIANCE cluster, plus the S96 W1 working-paper a(t) trajectory CF and the S96 w4 κ-pin workshop.

**Substrate-framing law for the whole wave** (per `.claude/rules/phononic-framing.md §"Exflation vs Inflation"`): every gate frames `a(t)` as *spectral-complexity growth / order-parameter dynamics*, NEVER "space expands." The deceleration parameter `q` is the curvature of the order-parameter trajectory in acoustic time; the conformal factor `Ω(τ)` is the order-parameter→acoustic-metric map; κ is the substrate-clock-tick (`M_KK⁻¹`) to SI-seconds normalization.

## §W1-1. S97-W1-OMEGA-PROFILE

```yaml
# ---- Identity ----
gate_id: "S97-W1-OMEGA-PROFILE"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[SIGN]"
classification: "GEOMETRIC"
agent_type: "volovik-superfluid-universe-theorist"
hypothesis: "The order-parameter↔acoustic conformal factor Ω(τ)=√(ρ_s/a₂) is NON-constant over τ∈[0.190,0.6] with well-defined Ω̇,Ω̈, and reproduces the S95-W4-4 anchor value Ω_BA at the fold; the alternative is a constant-Ω null (Ω̇=Ω̈=0) under which the acoustic deceleration parameter is identically the bare one."

method:
  description: "Load x(τ)=ρ_s/ρ_n from the two-fluid npz and a₂(τ) from the AOFT-Friedmann map npz. Reconstruct ρ_s(τ) = x(τ)·ρ_n(τ) on the same τ-grid (ρ_n the GGE normal-component density; ρ_s the unbroken-condensate vacuum density carrying the effacement residual Γ_effacement=0.99970). Form Ω(τ)=√(ρ_s(τ)/a₂(τ)); compute Ω̇=dΩ/dτ, Ω̈=d²Ω/dτ² by centered finite differences on the dense τ-grid (Savitzky–Golay smoothing window pinned). Export the triple (Ω, Ω̇, Ω̈) over τ∈[0.190,0.6]. Reproduce the fold-anchor Ω_BA(τ_fold) from the S95-W4-4 conformal-embed object to pre-registered tol. a₂ is the a_2^{ζ} Seeley–DeWitt second spectral moment read off the spectral-moment cache (regulator-tagged)."
  producing_script: "computations/_shared/s97_w1_omega_profile.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----
operator:
  type: "set"   # joint predicate: non-constancy AND derivative-existence AND fold-anchor reproduction
  form: "(max_τ|Ω(τ) − mean(Ω)| / mean(Ω) > eps_nonconst) AND (Ω̇,Ω̈ finite ∀τ) AND (|Ω(τ_fold) − Ω_BA_anchor|/Ω_BA_anchor ≤ tau_anchor)"

strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "eps_nonconst = 1e-3 (relative spread); tau_anchor = 1e-2 (fold-anchor rel tol)"
  direction: ">"   # relative spread strictly exceeds eps_nonconst for the non-constant branch

boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: false
  proof_ref: "N/A — non-constancy is an empirical property of the reconstructed Ω(τ); the constant-Ω null is the analytically-degenerate boundary (Ω̇=Ω̈=0), exactly characterized by the Sage check in substitution_chain below."

reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false
  mesh_density: "continuous τ-grid (1001 points on [0.190, 0.6])"

machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "1001"                       # τ-grid points on [0.190, 0.6]
  L_max: "10"                          # a₂ read from L_max=10 spectral-moment cache (matches S96-W1 a₂(τ) provenance)
  scan_range: "[0.190, 0.6]"           # τ-window (fold → late-time)
  step_size: "3.6e-4"                  # (0.6 − 0.190)/1000 uniform τ-spacing
  tolerance: "1e-12"                   # FD/array reconstruction residual floor
  scheme: "FW"                         # framework spectral-action convention
  convention: "RATIO"                  # Ω is a ratio √(ρ_s/a₂); fold-anchor compared as relative
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "numpy.linalg"             # 1D array reconstruction + FD; no large matrix (CPU)
  regulator_pin: "a_2^{ζ}"             # the a₂ Seeley–DeWitt moment is zeta-regulated (matches a_2_FW_zeta provenance); per regulator-pin-discipline.md
  eps_nonconst: "1e-3"                 # relative-spread threshold for the non-constant branch
  tau_anchor: "1e-2"                   # fold-anchor rel-tol for Ω_BA reproduction
  sg_window: "21"                      # Savitzky–Golay smoothing window (odd, < N_eval) for Ω̇,Ω̈ stability
  sg_polyorder: "3"                    # SG polynomial order (≥ 2 to admit a non-trivial Ω̈)
  Gamma_effacement: "0.99970"          # effacement residual carried by ρ_s (canonical, S37)
  Omega_BA_anchor_source: "s95_w4_4_sp_conformal_embed.npz (S95-W4-4 conformal-embed object; the fold conformal-factor value Ω_BA(τ_fold))"

audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    CLAIM A (the [SIGN]/null): "If Ω(τ) is constant (Ω̇=Ω̈=0) then the acoustic
    deceleration parameter q is identically the bare q." (This defines the null
    boundary that the PASS branch must exceed.)
      Def 1: a_acoustic(t) = Ω(t)·a_bare(t)        [conformal map, order-param→acoustic]
      Def 2: q ≡ −a·ä / ȧ²                          [deceleration parameter]
      Substitute: q_acoustic = −[Ω·a_bare]·d²/dt²[Ω·a_bare] / (d/dt[Ω·a_bare])²
      Simplify (set Ω̇=Ω̈=0, i.e. constant Ω):
              numerator → −Ω²·a_bare·ä_bare
              denominator → Ω²·ȧ_bare²
              q_acoustic → −a_bare·ä_bare / ȧ_bare² = q_bare
      Canonical form: q_acoustic(Ω̇=Ω̈=0) − q_bare = 0
      Direction: a constant Ω leaves q INVARIANT ⇒ a non-constant Ω is REQUIRED
                 for the conformal factor to carry independent acoustic-deceleration
                 content; the gate's PASS branch tests exactly this non-constancy.
      [Sage-verified at plan-freeze: q_acoustic(Ω̇=Ω̈=0) − q_bare simplify_full() = 0.]

    CLAIM B (the construction feeding CLAIM A's non-constancy test):
      Ω(τ) = √(ρ_s(τ)/a₂(τ)), ρ_s(τ) = x(τ)·ρ_n(τ); x(τ) from
      s96_w1_volovik_2fluid.npz (residual 4.55e-13), a₂(τ) = a_2^{ζ} from
      s96_w1_aoft_friedmann_map.npz (L_max=10 moment cache); Ω̇,Ω̈ by centered FD
      with SG smoothing (window 21, polyorder 3).
      Direction (the [SIGN] read-off): since x(τ) is monotone-increasing in a
      (Sage-exact d ln x/d ln a = 3(1+w_n) > 0, gate 1.2) while a₂(τ) varies
      independently with τ, the ratio ρ_s/a₂ is NOT constant ⇒ Ω̇ ≠ 0 on the
      generic branch ⇒ Ω(τ) carries independent acoustic-deceleration content
      (the PASS branch); the degenerate Ω̇=Ω̈=0 case is the INFO null of CLAIM A.

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: "Ω(τ) is non-constant (relative spread > 1e-3) with finite Ω̇,Ω̈ ∀τ AND reproduces Ω_BA(τ_fold) to rel 1e-2. The conformal factor carries independent acoustic-deceleration content; the order-param→acoustic bridge is a genuine non-trivial map, and the 1.3 leg-ii / 1.4 a(t) trajectory can consume (Ω,Ω̇,Ω̈). PREREQUISITE SATISFIED for 1.3 + 1.4."
FAIL_meaning: "Reconstruction does not yield a numerically usable (Ω,Ω̇,Ω̈) triple (e.g. ρ_s reconstruction inconsistent, a₂(τ) grid mismatch, or fold-anchor off by >1e-2). The conformal prerequisite is NOT exportable; 1.3 leg-ii and 1.4 are blocked and honestly close per mechanical-closure-discipline.md."
INFO_meaning: "Constant-Ω null fires: relative spread ≤ 1e-3 with Ω̇≈Ω̈≈0 to FD floor. Valid result — the conformal factor is (numerically) constant, so the acoustic deceleration is the bare one (Sage-exact q_acoustic−q_bare=0); 1.3 leg-ii transport collapses to q_bare and 1.4 reduces to a bare-order-parameter re-scaling. This is a LEG-COLLAPSE for downstream, NOT a block."

substrate_framing: |
  The substrate IS the spectral triple at order-parameter value τ. ρ_s is the
  unbroken-condensate vacuum energy density (the part of the substrate that has
  NOT decohered into GGE quasiparticles), and a₂ is the second Seeley–DeWitt
  spectral moment (a_2^{ζ}) of D_K that generates the emergent g_M. Their ratio's
  square root Ω(τ)=√(ρ_s/a₂) is the map from the substrate's intrinsic
  order-parameter clock to the acoustic-metric clock an external observer reads.
  This is NOT a scale factor on a pre-existing container; it is the conformal
  re-grading of spectral weight as τ advances past the fold. Flow:
  D_K eigenvalues → a₂ (2nd spectral moment) + ρ_s (condensate vacuum density)
  → Ω(τ) conformal factor → acoustic a(t) image. Exporting (Ω,Ω̇,Ω̈) makes the
  order-param→acoustic bridge a computable object, not an implicit one.
```

## §W1-2. S97-W1-XTODAY

```yaml
# ---- Identity ----
gate_id: "S97-W1-XTODAY"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[VERIFY]"
classification: "PHONONIC"
agent_type: "volovik-superfluid-universe-theorist"
hypothesis: "Integrating the two-fluid densities ρ_n ∝ a^{−3(1+w_n)} (GGE normal component, w_n∈[−0.4076,0] FROZEN) against ρ_s≈const from the fold to τ=0.6 yields x_today=ρ_s/ρ_n monotonically GREATER than x_fold=85.7928, with the late-time deceleration q(x_today)≈−1 (effacement-dominated vacuum); this fixes the substrate-determined A-PASS x-window for the route-invariance gate."

method:
  description: "Load x(τ) and the component densities from s96_w1_volovik_2fluid.npz. Integrate ρ_n(τ) ∝ a_eff(τ)^{−3(1+w_n)} with a_eff(τ) reconstructed from a₂(τ) (a_eff ∝ √a₂ on the AOFT map), against ρ_s(τ)≈const, over τ∈[τ_fold,0.6]. Compute x(τ)=ρ_s/ρ_n at τ_now (the late-τ endpoint), for both FROZEN band endpoints w_n=−0.4076 and w_n=0. Verify x_today>x_fold (monotone, Sage-exact via the d ln x/d ln a = 3(1+w_n)>0 identity). Compute the two-fluid deceleration q(x_today) from the w=0 (normal)/w=−1 (superfluid) EoS and confirm q→−1 as x→large (vacuum-dominated). Report x_today as a band over the w_n endpoints."
  producing_script: "computations/_shared/s97_w1_xtoday.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----
operator:
  type: "inequality"
  form: "(x_today > x_fold) AND (|q(x_today) − (−1)| ≤ tau_q)"

strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "x_fold = 85.7928 (lower bound for x_today); q_target = −1 with tau_q = 0.05"
  direction: ">"   # x_today strictly greater than x_fold

boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: "Monotonicity d ln x / d ln a = 3(1+w_n) is Sage-exact: = 3 at w_n=0, = 1.7772 at w_n=−0.4076; both > 0 ⇒ x increasing in a ⇒ x_today > x_fold for any a_today > a_fold. Boundary q→−1 is the x→∞ limit of the w∈{0,−1} two-fluid EoS."

reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false
  mesh_density: "continuous τ-grid (matched to the 2-fluid npz grid); 2-point w_n band {−0.4076, 0}"

machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "1001"                       # τ-grid (matched to volovik_2fluid npz)
  L_max: "10"                          # a₂(τ) → a_eff(τ) from L_max=10 cache
  scan_range: "[0.190, 0.6]"           # τ integration window
  step_size: "3.6e-4"                  # uniform τ-spacing (matched to 1.1)
  tolerance: "1e-10"                   # cumulative-integration residual floor
  scheme: "FW"
  convention: "RATIO"                  # x is a density ratio; q compared as absolute to −1
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "numpy.linalg"             # 1D cumulative integration; CPU
  w_n_endpoints: "[-0.4076, 0.0]"      # S67 GGE-TWO-FLUID-67 FROZEN band endpoints (both evaluated; band reported)
  x_fold: "85.7928"                    # S67 ODLRO fold value (lower-bound threshold)
  q_target: "-1.0"                     # late-time vacuum-dominated deceleration target
  tau_q: "0.05"                        # absolute tolerance on q(x_today) − (−1)
  rho_s_model: "const"                 # superfluid density taken ≈const (unbroken-condensate vacuum, w=−1)

audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    CLAIM (the [VERIFY] monotonicity + sign): "x_today > x_fold."
      Def 1: x = ρ_s / ρ_n                                  [superfluid/normal density ratio]
      Def 2: ρ_s ≈ const                                    [unbroken-condensate vacuum, w=−1]
      Def 3: ρ_n ∝ a^{−3(1+w_n)}                            [GGE normal gas, w_n∈[−0.4076,0]]
      Substitute: x ∝ a^{+3(1+w_n)}
      Differentiate (log): d ln x / d ln a = 3(1+w_n)
      Simplify (endpoints): w_n=0   → 3      (>0)
                            w_n=−0.4076 → 1.7772  (>0)
      Canonical form: d ln x / d ln a = 3(1+w_n) > 0 ∀ w_n ∈ [−0.4076, 0]
      Direction: x is strictly increasing in a; since a advances (a_today > a_fold
                 as τ runs fold→0.6), x_today > x_fold = 85.7928.
      [Sage-verified at plan-freeze: 3*w_n+3, evaluated +3 and +1.7772 at the endpoints.]

    CLAIM 2 (late-time deceleration, sign): "q(x_today) ≈ −1."
      Two-fluid EoS: p_n=0 (w=0 dust), p_s=−ρ_s (w=−1 vacuum).
      As x=ρ_s/ρ_n → large, the total EoS w_tot = p_tot/ρ_tot → −1 (vacuum-dominated),
      and the FRW deceleration q = ½(1+3w_tot) → −1.
      Direction: increasing x drives q monotonically toward −1; q(x_today)≈−1 confirms
                 the late-τ endpoint is vacuum/effacement-dominated.
```

```yaml
# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: "κ_implied ∈ [1e-20,1e-10] OR recovers κ_nat=8.86e-42 to |log10|≤0.5, AND the pre-flight confirmed the exponent is κ-independent. The SCENARIO-A cooling budget over-determines the M_KK⁻¹→s knob — pinning the last free parameter blocking the explicit a(t) seconds-normalization (resolves 1.4 INFO) and the CGWB peak. HIGH-leverage C1 closure."
FAIL_meaning: "The pre-flight FAILS — the cooling exponent secretly carries the seconds-normalization (∂(exponent)/∂κ ≠ 0), making the κ-pin a tautology (Class-8.7 degenerate-observable). The budget cannot independently PIN κ; the gate is vacuous and the knob stays swept."
INFO_meaning: "Pre-flight passes (exponent κ-independent) but κ_implied is finite and OUTSIDE [1e-20,1e-10] and farther than 0.5 decade from κ_nat. The budget constrains κ but does not pin it to the natural value — the seconds-normalization is bounded but not fixed; κ stays a (narrowed) swept knob for Wave-4."

    - "computations/session-97/s97_cooling_budget_kappa_pin.npz"

substrate_framing: |
  κ is the substrate-clock-tick-to-SI-seconds normalization: the dimensionless
  order-parameter time τ ticks at M_KK⁻¹ seconds, and κ=M_KK_inv_seconds is that
  conversion. The SCENARIO-A cooling budget is the substrate's own thermodynamic
  record of the fold-to-now transit: T_init is the post-fold temperature, N_e_exfl
  the number of exflationary e-folds (spectral-complexity doublings), and the
  cooling exponent −0.8685 the per-e-fold log-temperature decline. CRUCIALLY this
  exponent is a ratio of dimensionless substrate quantities (a spectral-flow ratio)
  — it carries NO seconds, so it does not already contain κ. That κ-independence is
  what lets the budget INDEPENDENTLY pin κ rather than tautologically reproduce it.
  This is the substrate-IS reading of "fixing the time-normalization of the
  expansion": not calibrating a clock against an external standard, but reading the
  substrate's own thermodynamic budget to over-determine its clock tick. Flow:
  D_K spectrum → cooling budget (T_init, N_e, exponent) + H²(τ*) → seconds-per-e-fold
  → κ_implied. NON-PHONONIC caveat: the seconds-conversion arithmetic (ħ_SI, GeV_to_J)
  is a unit-chain, not substrate dynamics — but the budget that feeds it IS substrate.
```

## Wave 1 → Wave 2 Decision Point

Wave 1 is internally sequenced but carries NO hard prerequisite into Wave 2 (CC closure & spectral-moment robustness) — Waves 2–6 are parallel-dispatchable against S96-landed inputs. The intra-wave routing below governs Wave 1's own internal order and what each verdict feeds into the C1 a(t) frontier closure narrative + the capstone §6.3 / Atlas-04 C1/C2 reconciliation.

**Intra-wave sequencing (pinned by the S96 w1-workshop E2):**

```
S97-W1-OMEGA-PROFILE (1.1)
   ├── PASS (non-constant Ω) ─▶ 1.3 leg-ii transport ENABLED; 1.4 a(τ)→a(t) bridge ENABLED
   ├── INFO (constant-Ω null) ─▶ 1.3 leg-ii COLLAPSES to q_bare (Sage-exact); 1.4 reduces to bare-order-param re-scaling. Both still RUN (downstream LEG-COLLAPSE, not block).
   └── FAIL (no usable Ω triple) ─▶ 1.3 leg-ii + 1.4 BLOCKED → honest mechanical closure (mechanical-closure-discipline.md): emit FAIL value='PRE-REG-INC_blocked_by_S97-W1-OMEGA-PROFILE_FAIL'.

S97-W1-XTODAY (1.2)  ── folds into ──▶ 1.3 A-window (x-range for the A-PASS shortfall test)
   ├── PASS ─▶ A-window substrate-determined; 1.3 A-leg uses x_today band.
   └── FAIL/INFO ─▶ 1.3 A-leg uses the S96 x_today fallback (flag the substitution).

S97-W1-QOMEGA-ROUTE-INVARIANCE (1.3)  [consumes 1.1 BLOCKER + 1.2 A-window]
   ├── C-PASS / B-PASS ─▶ q_Ω route-invariant (Track A): C1 a(t) deceleration is substrate-intrinsic; capstone §6.3 a(t) gap status strengthens. Run Q3 capstone-hygiene gate.
   └── A-PASS (shortfall fires) ─▶ q_Ω route-sensitive (Track B): C1 deceleration CONDITIONAL on route; Atlas-04 C1/C2 stays CONDITIONAL.

S97-W1-1-AT-TRAJECTORY (1.4)  [consumes 1.1 BLOCKER]
   ├── PASS ─▶ explicit normalization-pinned a(t) delivered; C1 frontier closes existence→explicit-trajectory.
   └── INFO (1-param τ̇ band) ─▶ a(t) exists+anchored but seconds-scaling is the κ-knob → resolved by 1.5 PASS.

S97-COOLING-BUDGET-KAPPA-PIN (1.5)  [parallel; HIGH priority]
   ├── PASS ─▶ κ pinned → resolves any 1.4 INFO seconds-band; Wave-4 4.1/4.2 may consume κ as cross-check.
   ├── INFO ─▶ κ bounded-not-pinned; 1.4 seconds-band persists; Wave-4 keeps sweeping κ.
   └── FAIL (Class-8.7 vacuous) ─▶ κ-pin route closed; the cooling budget does NOT over-determine κ. Log the Class-8.7 disambiguator outcome.
```

**Capstone-hygiene routing (Q1/Q3 of the 5-question gate, `.claude/rules/capstone-hygiene-gate.md`)**: this wave touches the §6.3 effective-Friedmann `a(t)` gap (Q1 YES) and may change the C1 PROVEN/CONDITIONAL status (Q3 YES). On any 1.3/1.4/1.5 verdict that alters the §6.3 gap or the C1 status, route the capstone-update action into `sessions/archive/session-97/session-97-housekeeping.md` §A (in-session designated-writer fix) or §B (compute carry-forward), and reconcile Atlas-04 C1/C2 tags. The §6.3 prose owner is the capstone designated writer; the §7 falsifier-TABLE cells (if any a(t) falsifier row changes) are `mack-cosmic-bridge`.
